people.name: Smyrna
people.line: One of the seven churches of Asia Minor

translations.web: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:
translations.bsb: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.
translations.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
translations.asv: And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These things saith the first and the last, who was dead, and lived again:
